name: com.ecanakli.uidirector
description: Runs your Screens, Popups & Overlays. Prefab views under one persistent root, typed keys, awaitable results, one back rule and a priority queue. Requires UniTask.

samples.description: Core only: a confirm popup with a result, three screens with back, a system overlay, a custom layer and transition, events and errors. Needs TextMesh Pro Essential Resources.
A priority queue for popups: startup notices, a gate that denies, a hold while a flow runs, a feature catalog added at run time. Needs TextMesh Pro Essential Resources.
Requires com.unity.addressables. Views loaded by address, a preload lease and trimming kept instances.
Requires DOTween. TweenTransition on a popup and a custom transition built on DOTween.
Requires the Zenject integration to be active. The navigator bound in a SceneContext and views that receive injections.
